title: item hints one sentence
name: Item hints one sentence — GOV.UK
rule: Item hints: one short sentence, no full stops; no links in hint text.

citation.source: GOV.UK Design System — Radios; GOV.UK Design System — Select

pass_when: Per-item hint is one short sentence without a full stop and without links.
fail_when: Multi-sentence hints, trailing full stops, or links inside hint text.
overview: Per-item hints are one short sentence with no full stop and no links.
apply_when: Adding hint text under individual radio or select options.
not_when: Not for page-level help, field labels, or error messages.
agent_hint: Keep each item hint to one short sentence; ban trailing full stops and links.
description: Hints on individual radio or select items should be one short sentence, without a trailing full stop, and without links inside the hint text. Short, link-free hints keep options scannable and avoid nesting navigation inside the choice. Multi-sentence or link-filled hints compete with the option label itself. Fail for multi-sentence hints, trailing full stops, or links nested in hint copy. Use this when adding per-item help under radios or select options.
